Marks U.S. clinical execution, a key step toward potential FDA pathway and commercialization.
Validates scientific merit and de-risks study financing; reduces cash burn pressure.
Regulatory oversight increases credibility and may ease future submissions if data are positive.
Long timeline tempers near-term revenue impact; catalysts likely interim data/events.
Study combines OI, TMR, EMG, nerve electrodes
If efficacious, could expand addressable market vs socket or bone-only systems.

This is an early-stage clinical milestone expanding Integrum’s U.S. footprint from FDA-approved OPRA toward intelligent bionics. For a larger catalyst, investors need interim safety/efficacy readouts, enrollment progress, or regulatory/designation updates.
